articles.title: Extinct for 60 Years? Not So Fast—Citizen Scientist Snaps a Living Fossil
articles.summary: A horticulturalist bird-banding in remote Queensland photographed a plant unseen since 1967. iNaturalist led a botanist to confirm it's alive, moving it from 'extinct' to 'critically endangered.'

articles.title: From Ocean Floor to Lunar Surface: The Geologist Behind Artemis Astronaut Training
articles.summary: Cindy Evans, a former oceanographer, now leads geology training for Artemis crews. Her curriculum turns astronauts into field scientists who can decode the Moon's ancient past from orbit and on foot.

articles.title: Loan Limits for Nursing Grad Students Spark 24-State Lawsuit
articles.summary: A Trump administration rule caps federal loans for certain healthcare graduate programs, excluding nursing from 'professional' degree exemptions. States argue it will worsen provider shortages, especially in rural areas.
